verdict.rationale: Premium and aftermarket domain handling is a fair question for a domain registrar, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack covers premium pricing in search results or a marketplace or broker path for taken names. The only search-adjacent item is a generic availability-check SDK method, which does not address premium or aftermarket names.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names
